title: AI Web Crawlers: Answers From Your Website, With Links | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Much of what customers ask is already answered on your website. A CrestApps AI web crawler reads a website page by page on a schedule, through its sitemap, and keeps an assistant's knowledge current, so answers come with a link back to the page.

In this video:
• Why copying pages by hand goes stale, and how a crawler follows the website
• How the knowledge base index, the Web data source and the web crawler fit together
• Creating the index and a Web data source
• Adding a Sitemap web crawler: Base URL, limits, URL patterns and the schedule
• Reading the website now
• Giving an assistant the data source, and an answer that links to its page
• Use cases

chapters.title: Give the assistant the data source
